name: larkin
description: A café site built around the four things people check: where, when, what, and can I work here

scripts.build: node scripts/headers.mjs && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('node_modules/.astro', { recursive: true, force: true })" && astro build
scripts.check: node -e "try{require.resolve('@astrojs/check');require.resolve('typescript')}catch{console.error('astro check needs @astrojs/check and typescript. Run: npm install');process.exit(1)}" && astro check

docs.launchContent: put the café's details in `src/data/business.json`, wording in `src/i18n/*.json`, shops and opening hours in `src/content/locations/`, items in `src/content/menu/` (`docs/README.md` sections 2 and 4)
docs.launchEditorTry: They open **Menu**, change one item's price and save; a commit `Update Menu “…”` appears in the repository and the host rebuilds.
docs.launchHandover: adds the client's GitHub account to the repository as a collaborator with write access, and tells the client what the editor covers (`docs/README.md` section 8).

author: Alder Themes
